description: Output of 6_build/resource_ids.ts: the stable id of every row the loader produces, one per row, in row order, then rows that have left the data as retired. The id is the row's resource_id, with -2, -3 ... where it repeats, or feature-N for a row without one. Committed, so an id never changes or is reused.

resource_id.description: the resource_id at the time of the last build; may repeat

organization_name.description: with the address, how a row is recognised across builds
